newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei end little change after brief selling.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei end little change after brief selling.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures rebounded from the afternoon's low to end little change on Thursday.
The Nikkei contract weakened in the early afternoon following the softer dollar against the yen.
"Some stops were triggered on the way down at around 21,400 level but buying came back in quite quickly," said a dealer with an Asian futures firm.
He said there seem to be good insitutional interest at below 21,400 for the index.
The December Nikkei ended at 21,485 against 21,470 previously. Volume was a light at 11,580 contracts.
Technically, the index should see some support on the downside at 21,350 and resistance on the upside is seen at 21,650, said the dealer.
